verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT replacement whose app ecosystem 'runs entirely on your hardware.' The repo includes a build script that installs dependencies, builds the core components and launches the app. Its built-in llama.cpp-powered OpenAI-compatible server runs locally and can be exposed on 0.0.0.0 to other devices on the network, so the core product is fully self-hostable. Missing for 10: explicit license terms in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting, and documentation of headless/server deployment beyond the desktop app.
